protocol.pairing: Each FPS core coordinate, in deterministic FPS order, takes its nearest still-unused noncore coordinate by Gaussian kernel distance; ties use smallest original row index.
protocol.rotation: Permutation[J,pairedT,remainder]; core columns c*eJ+s*eT, paired tail columns -s*eJ+c*eT. Zero alignment vector uses identity.
protocol.checkpoint_policy: Full reconstructed x10 and x9; all delayed branches receive identical x10 transformed by Q transpose. Core reconstruction is an implicit Galerkin correction, recorded separately; its work is free in this oracle.
protocol.stopping: Literal original b-Ax is formed and checked every iteration. No reduced-only endpoint; no residual replacement or fallback.
protocol.offline: Dense K,A,exact reference solution, pairing, rotations and Schur rebuilds are free oracle resources. Diagnostic runtime is not native performance. No assumed transformed n²-m² kernel-entry cost or memory advantage.
protocol.interpretation: Exact-error alignment uses unavailable ground truth; only headroom, not an adaptive algorithm.
